summary: Add host to pool no longer asks for the pool master peer address. When no master_url is supplied and none is recorded, the master works out its own peer origin from the address its pool-peer listener is bound to, falling back to the default-route source address for a wildcard bind, records it as its member peer_origin, and the Controller forwards the invitation's master_url to the joining host. API impact: changed contract — POST /api/v1/pools/{id}/members master_url becomes a pure optional override, the 'has not advertised a peer origin' 409 is gone, and the invite PoolRequest accepts an empty master_url.

guide.reason: The join workflow drops the pool master address step and documents the new no-default-route refusal.

api.reason: master_url is now optional end to end: Core derives the master origin when it is empty, and the Controller forwards the invitation's master_url. Masters built before this change refuse an empty master_url with their existing origin error.

roadmap.reason: Usability fix inside the existing Phase 4 join slice.

state.reason: The master's peer origin stays in the master's pool membership record (its own member peer_origin) on Nex Core; a fresh Controller reads it back from the reported membership. Limit: a derived origin is pinned once it is recorded, so a later explicit master_url cannot move it; on Nex Core the default route is the management interface by design, and an operator who binds the listener elsewhere gets that address instead.
state.record: Pool master membership record, master member row peer_origin; recovered from inventory.managed.membership.

verification.method: go build ./..., go vet ./internal/... ./cmd/..., go test -count=1 ./internal/agent/ ./internal/controller/ ./internal/localcore/ (TestPoolJoinInvitationWorksOutMasterPeerOrigin now covers a non-default listen address; TestAnEjectedRowDoesNotHoldAMachineIdentityForEver and TestADisclaimedMasteryStaysInsideThePool added, each confirmed failing with the fix reverted), npm test and tsc in web/, generate_api.py --check, check_docs.py --worktree and the repository privacy test. No disposable two-host lab join or browser capture was run for this change.
